description: Search drinking water systems (SDWIS) by state or ZIP code. Returns system name, PWSID, population served, primary water source, and active violation status. Use to identify community water systems with current or recent compliance violations. At least one of state or zip_code is required.

has_violation.description: When true, return only systems with active violations

limit.description: Maximum number of systems to return (1–200)

pws_type.description: Filter by public water system type: community=permanent residences, non-transient=regular non-residents (schools, businesses), transient=occasional users (campgrounds)

name: epa_search_water_systems

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_geographic_filter`: Neither state nor zip_code was provided. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.
Recovery hint when no systems are found. Absent when systems are returned.

items.description: Public water system record with PWSID, population served, and violation status

city.description: City served by this water system

hasViolation.description: Whether this system has an active compliance violation on record

isActive.description: Whether this water system is currently active

populationServed.description: Estimated population served by this water system

primarySourceCode.description: Primary water source code (e.g. GW=groundwater, SW=surface water)

pwsid.description: Public Water System ID (PWSID) — unique system identifier

type.description: PWS type code: CWS=Community, NTNCWS=Non-transient non-community, TNCWS=Transient non-community

title: Search Drinking Water Systems
